title: The Bread Shaped in Pairs
youtube_title: The Bread Shaped in Pairs | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Two careful pairs of hands can do what one rush cannot.
summary: At a harbor dock where baskets are passed up, a braided loaf that needed one person to start the cross will go wrong if one person rushes. Esme and Bibi split it into two slow jobs, while Uncle Idris only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
